items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think Butter Beans and Suzie made an AZ blues. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. Yeah. They did.

ctx.x: That was made with the old blues. Yeah, the old blues. Never did come out.
Yeah, I never heard of it. I think Butter Beans and Suzie made an AZ blues.
Yes. Yeah. They did. But not your band. No. I mean that didn't come out. No.
